CONFIRMATION, RE-DESIGNATION, REGULARIZATION, RETIREMENT ON MEDICAL GROUNDS, CORRIGENDA AND STUDY LEAVE

The Secretary, Education Service Commission, informs Teaching and Non-Teaching personnel whose names appear in the  document attached herewith that the following actions below have been taken against their submissions:

  1. Confirmed in Service
  2. Re-Designation
  3. Appointment Regularized
  4. Retirement on Medical Grounds
  5. Corrigenda Made
  6. Study Leave

The concerned personnel are requested to contact the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Education and Sports, for issuance of the relevant letters.

item.content:encoded:
NOTICE

13th OCTOBER, 2026

RELEASE OF INTERVIEW RESULTS FOR APPOINTED PERSONNEL FOR DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION & SOCIAL SERVICES,

KAMPALA CAPITAL CITY AUTHORITY

The Secretary, Education Service Commission, informs candidates who sat for interviews between 21st – 22nd September 2026 in respect of internal Advert No. 1/2026 and 28th – 30th September 2026 in respect of external Advert No. 1/2026 for KAMPALA CAPITAL CITY AUTHORITY GRANT AIDED PRIMARY SCHOOLS that results are hereby released

Appointed personnel should pick up their NOTIFICATION LETTERS  in person from the Education Service Commission Registry on the first floor, Room 111, Farmers House at Parliamentary Avenue on TUESDAY 20th OCTOBER, 2026.

Note:

  1. Please come along with your original National Identification Card.
  2. Those whose names don’t appear on the lists should consider themselves unsuccessful.

Click the link below for details;

POST: EDUCATION ASSISTANT, KAMPALA CAPITAL CITY AUTHORITY (KCCA)

DATE: 28th TO 30th SEPTEMBER 2026

VENUE: EDUCATION SERVICE COMMISSION OFFICES 1st FLOOR, FARMERS’ HOUSE, PARLIAMENT AVENUE

The Secretary, Education Service Commission, informs applicants for the Post of  Education Assistant in Kampala Capital City Authority (KCCA), advertised under External Advert No. 1/2026, that Addendum shortlist for successful candidates for oral interviews is hereby released on the Education website: https://www.esc.go.ug/

Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to oral interviews from Monday 28th to Wednesday 30th September 2026.

The interviews will be conducted at the Education Service Commission Offices, 1st Floor, Farmers’ House, Parliament Avenue, starting at 8:00 am each day.

item.content:encoded:
LIST OF APPOINTED INDIVIDUALS WHO HAVE NOT YET PICKED THEIR NOTIFICATION LETTERS
The Secretary, Education Service Commission, invites the following individuals who were appointed by the Education Service Commission, but never picked their Notification Letters, to pick them not later than 15th October 2026. The affected individuals should note that beyond 15th October 2026, any unpicked Notification Letters will cease to be valid.
The list is available on the ESC website: https://www.esc.ug .go

NOTE

  1. Each affected person should present valid identification cards/documents
  2. Notification letters will be picked from the ESC Registry on working days between 8:00 am – 5:00 pm
  3. Please ignore this information if you already picked your Notification Letter

Click on the link below to view the list of individuals in the subject mentioned above
